hook: The prayer we repeat in every rak'ah.
hook_you: Do you feel what you say in every prayer?

hook: Ayat al-Kursi, the greatest verse in the Quran.
hook_you: Recite this before you sleep tonight.

hook: The closing verses of Surah Al-Baqarah.
hook_you: Say it with the believers: we hear and we obey.

hook: Allah does not burden a soul beyond what it can bear.
hook_you: Feel like it's more than you can carry?

hook: When My servants ask about Me, I am near.
hook_you: Wondering if Allah hears your dua?

hook: Remember Me, and I will remember you.
hook_you: Want Allah to remember you?

hook: Give good news to the patient.
hook_you: Going through a loss right now?

hook: Our Lord, give us good in this world and good in the Hereafter.
hook_you: The dua that asks for the best of both worlds.

hook: You may dislike something that is good for you.
hook_you: Upset that something didn't go your way?

hook: Seek help through patience and prayer.
hook_you: Overwhelmed? This is where to turn.

hook: This is the Book about which there is no doubt.
hook_you: Looking for guidance you can trust?

hook: Our Lord, do not let our hearts deviate after You have guided us.
hook_you: Afraid of losing your faith? Ask Him this.

hook: You give sovereignty to whom You will.
hook_you: Everything you hope for is in His hand.

hook: Hasten to forgiveness and a Garden as wide as the heavens and the earth.
hook_you: Forgiveness is waiting. Will you hurry to it?

hook: Do not weaken and do not grieve.
hook_you: Feeling weak and sad today?

hook: If Allah helps you, no one can overcome you.
hook_you: Feel like everyone is against you?

hook: Allah is sufficient for us, and He is the best Disposer of affairs.
hook_you: Scared of what people are planning?

hook: Every soul will taste death.
hook_you: Everything you're chasing will end. Then what?

hook: In the creation of the heavens and the earth are signs.
hook_you: Ever looked at the night sky and wondered?

hook: With Him are the keys of the unseen.
hook_you: Not a single leaf falls without Him knowing.

hook: My prayer, my sacrifice, my living and my dying are for Allah.
hook_you: Who are you really living for?

hook: The prayer of Adam: Our Lord, we have wronged ourselves.
hook_you: Feel you've wronged yourself? Say this.

hook: Do not grieve, Allah is with us.
hook_you: Feeling alone in a hard moment?

hook: Allah is sufficient for me. There is no god but Him.
hook_you: Do you know how much he cared about you?

hook: A healing for what is in the hearts.
hook_you: Is your heart hurting? There is healing.

hook: There is no creature on earth except that Allah provides for it.
hook_you: Worried about your provision?

hook: I only complain of my grief and sorrow to Allah.
hook_you: Carrying a sadness no one sees?

hook: Let me die a Muslim and join me with the righteous.
hook_you: Ask for the best ending with this dua.

hook: In the remembrance of Allah do hearts find rest.
hook_you: Looking for peace in your heart?

hook: If you are grateful, I will surely give you more.
hook_you: Want more blessings in your life?

hook: A good word is like a good tree.
hook_you: Your words can be like this tree.

hook: My Lord, make me establish prayer, and my descendants too.
hook_you: A dua for you, your parents and your children.

hook: Worship your Lord until certainty comes to you.
hook_you: Hurt by what people say about you?

hook: If you tried to count the favours of Allah, you could never count them.
hook_you: Try counting your blessings today.

hook: Whoever does good as a believer, We will give them a good life.
hook_you: Want a good life? Here is the promise.

hook: Your Lord has decreed that you worship none but Him, and be good to your parents.
hook_you: Are your parents still with you?

hook: We send down in the Quran healing and mercy for the believers.
hook_you: The Quran is healing. Let it in.

hook: The opening of Surah Al-Kahf.
hook_you: The surah many read every Friday.

hook: Our Lord, grant us mercy from Yourself.
hook_you: Feeling lost? Make the dua of the youths in the cave.

hook: Wealth and children are the adornment of this world.
hook_you: What will you really leave behind?

hook: The closing verses of Surah Al-Kahf.
hook_you: Imagine a home you'd never want to leave.

hook: Zakariyya called upon his Lord in secret.
hook_you: Make your dua in secret, like Zakariyya did.

hook: The story of Maryam.
hook_you: The moment an angel came to Maryam.

hook: Maryam beneath the palm tree.
hook_you: In her hardest moment, help came from below.

hook: Everyone in the heavens and the earth will come to the Most Merciful as a servant.
hook_you: Everyone, without exception, comes to Him as a servant.

hook: We did not send down the Quran to you to cause you distress.
hook_you: Feeling stressed? The Quran wasn't sent to burden you.

hook: My Lord, expand my chest and ease my task for me.
hook_you: Nervous about something today? Say this.

hook: Do not fear. I am with you both, I hear and I see.
hook_you: Afraid? Hear what Allah told Musa.

hook: My Lord, increase me in knowledge.
hook_you: Studying or learning? Say this dua.

hook: Whoever turns away from My remembrance will have a hard life.
hook_you: What happens when you turn away from His remembrance.

hook: The prayer of Ayyub: harm has touched me, and You are the Most Merciful.
hook_you: In pain? Pray like Ayyub prayed.

hook: The prayer of Yunus from the darkness.
hook_you: Trapped in darkness? Say what Yunus said.

hook: My Lord, do not leave me alone.
hook_you: Feeling alone? Make this dua.

hook: Successful indeed are the believers.
hook_you: What do the truly successful have in common?

hook: Did you think We created you without purpose?
hook_you: Ever wondered why you were created?

hook: Allah is the Light of the heavens and the earth.
hook_you: Looking for light in your life?

hook: The servants of the Most Merciful walk upon the earth humbly.
hook_you: Are you one of the servants of the Most Merciful?

hook: Our Lord, grant us spouses and children who are the comfort of our eyes.
hook_you: A dua for your spouse and children.

hook: He feeds me and gives me drink, and when I am ill He heals me.
hook_you: When you're ill, remember who heals.

hook: Who answers the distressed when they call upon Him?
hook_you: Desperate? He answers the one who calls.

hook: My Lord, I am in need of whatever good You send down to me.
hook_you: Need something good in your life? Ask like Musa.

hook: Every soul will taste death, then to Us you will be returned.
hook_you: Every soul will taste death. Are you ready?

hook: Those who strive for Us, We will surely guide them to Our ways.
hook_you: Struggling to stay on the right path?

hook: He placed between you love and mercy.
hook_you: The love in your marriage is a sign from Allah.

hook: Luqman's advice to his son.
hook_you: A father's advice to his son, from the Quran.

hook: Remember Allah with much remembrance.
hook_you: Want light in your heart? Remember Him.

hook: Send blessings upon the Prophet.
hook_you: Allah and His angels send blessings on him. Will you?

hook: The opening of Surah Yasin.
hook_you: Pause for a moment with Surah Ya-Sin.

hook: The people of Paradise, busy in joy.
hook_you: Imagine the joy waiting in Paradise.

hook: The closing verses of Surah Yasin.
hook_you: Ever wondered how He brings the bones back to life?

hook: The patient will be given their reward without measure.
hook_you: Your patience is not going unnoticed.

hook: Do not despair of the mercy of Allah.
hook_you: Think you've sinned too much to be forgiven?

hook: Those who feared their Lord will be led to Paradise in groups.
hook_you: Imagine the gates of Paradise opening for you.

hook: I entrust my affair to Allah.
hook_you: Can't control the outcome? Hand it to Allah.

hook: Call upon Me, I will respond to you.
hook_you: Allah is asking you to call on Him.

hook: Do not fear and do not grieve, receive good news of Paradise.
hook_you: What the angels will say to the steadfast.

hook: We are closer to him than his jugular vein.
hook_you: He is closer to you than you think.

hook: I did not create jinn and mankind except to worship Me.
hook_you: Ever asked yourself why you exist?

hook: The Most Merciful taught the Quran.
hook_you: Look at what the Most Merciful gave you.

hook: Everyone on earth will perish, and the Face of your Lord remains.
hook_you: Everything you see will perish, except Him.

hook: For whoever fears standing before his Lord are two gardens.
hook_you: Fear standing before Him? Two gardens await.

hook: When the inevitable event occurs.
hook_you: When that Day comes, nothing will be the same.

hook: When the soul reaches the throat.
hook_you: One day the soul reaches the throat. Then what?

hook: Has the time not come for the hearts of the believers to be humbled?
hook_you: Has the time not come for your heart?

hook: If We had sent down this Quran upon a mountain.
hook_you: If this Quran came down on a mountain...

hook: He is Allah, other than whom there is no god.
hook_you: Get to know Allah through His names.

hook: Whoever relies upon Allah, He is sufficient for him.
hook_you: Worried about tomorrow? Rely on Him.

hook: Blessed is He in whose hand is the dominion.
hook_you: Why did Allah create life and death?

hook: Ask forgiveness of your Lord, He is ever Forgiving.
hook_you: Seeking forgiveness brings more than you think.

hook: Stand in prayer by night.
hook_you: Who's awake tonight? This is for you.

hook: When the soul reaches the collarbones.
hook_you: Think about the moment the soul leaves the body.

hook: They fulfil their vows and fear a Day whose evil will be widespread.
hook_you: Give for Allah alone, expecting no thanks.

hook: For the righteous is success.
hook_you: What awaits those who were mindful of Allah?

hook: Whoever feared standing before his Lord, Paradise is their refuge.
hook_you: Two paths. Which one are you on?

hook: The Day a man will flee from his brother.
hook_you: The Day you'll run from your own family.

hook: When the sun is wrapped up.
hook_you: Imagine the day the sun goes dark.

hook: O mankind, what has deceived you about your Lord, the Most Generous?
hook_you: What has deceived you about your Lord?

hook: Glorify the name of your Lord, the Most High.
hook_you: Say it with me: Subhana Rabbiyal A'la.

hook: Faces that Day will be joyful.
hook_you: Imagine your effort finally being rewarded.

hook: O reassured soul, return to your Lord, well-pleased and pleasing.
hook_you: The words every soul hopes to hear.

hook: No! When the earth is pounded to dust.
hook_you: That Day, man will remember. Will it be too late?

hook: Your Lord has not forsaken you.
hook_you: Feel like Allah has forgotten you?

hook: With hardship comes ease.
hook_you: Going through something hard? Listen.

hook: The Night of Decree is better than a thousand months.
hook_you: Imagine one night better than a thousand months.

hook: By time, mankind is in loss.
hook_you: Are you losing without knowing it?

hook: When the victory of Allah comes.
hook_you: When help comes, what should you do?

hook: Say: He is Allah, the One.
hook_you: A third of the Quran in four short lines.

hook: Say: I seek refuge in the Lord of daybreak.
hook_you: Protect yourself from envy and harm.

hook: Say: I seek refuge in the Lord of mankind.
hook_you: Hearing whispers in your heart? Seek refuge.

hook: Indeed, We have granted you al-Kawthar.
hook_you: Do you know the shortest surah of the Quran?

hook: Those who fear their Lord unseen will have forgiveness and great reward.
hook_you: Do you fear Allah even when no one sees you?

hook: None holds them aloft except the Most Merciful.
hook_you: Who keeps the birds up in the sky?

hook: No disaster strikes except by permission of Allah.
hook_you: Something bad happened? Read this.

hook: We have certainly created man in the best of stature.
hook_you: You were created in the best form.

hook: The Striking Calamity. What is the Striking Calamity?
hook_you: What will make your scales heavy?

hook: Competition in worldly increase diverts you until you visit the graveyards.
hook_you: Chasing more and more? Until when?

hook: For you is your religion, and for me is my religion.
hook_you: Stand firm in your faith with these words.

hook: And He is the Forgiving, the Affectionate.
hook_you: Need to hear that Allah is loving and forgiving?
